environment.runtime: fixture validators plus independent fresh-context semantic review

datasets: bundled regression routing.json and behavior.json for each donor

holdout_policy.rule: Do not store answer-bearing holdout cases in donor bundles or expose them to mutating specialists.

criteria.routing: every negative case names its neighboring route and independent review finds no blocking collision
criteria.behavior: expected and forbidden properties are explicit and independent review finds no blocker
criteria.authority: no candidate self-activation or authority expansion
criteria.documentation: path containment, ownership, decision authority and false-completion negatives pass
criteria.coexistence: single-agent, team, Agent OS and skill routes have explicit precedence
criteria.lifecycle: registration, evaluation, activation and retirement remain separate
